title: When the Blue Hour Turns
author: Odile Pemberton
blurb: Ansel Ishikawa, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
